name: Manhattan Community Award Program (MCAP) (2007-2017)
description:
This dataset records awards made through the Manhattan Community Award Program (MCAP) from fiscal years 2007 through 2017. Each row represents a single allocation to a community organization, showing the fiscal year, the city agency involved, the recipient organization, the project title, and the dollar amount awarded. There are about 1,956 sampled rows across five columns.

The fiscal year field spans 2007 to 2017, with a small share of missing values.
